Name: Online Shop
Author: Dominikkovi
Description:
OnlineShop adds a virtual in-game shop that lets players purchase essential resources without ever leaving their farm — built specifically for the [b]No-Exit Challenge[/b].
Press [b]B[/b] (configurable) while free on your farm to open the shop. Five categories are available:
[list]
[*][b]Farming Shop[/b] – Seeds, saplings, sprinklers, artisan equipment[/*]
[*][b]Mining Shop[/b] – Ores, bars, geodes, bombs, machines[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Shop[/b] – Rods, bait, tackle[/*]
[*][b]Online Bookstore[/b] – Power Books & Skill Books (1.6)[/*]
[*][b]Special Offers[/b] – Daily rotating discounted items[/*]
[/list]To preserve progression balance, most items are locked behind skill gates. Higher-tier items only unlock as your farming, mining, and fishing skills grow.
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already[/*]
[*]Drop the
[code]OnlineShop[/code]folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI — not Steam directly[/*]
[/list]A
[code]config.json[/code]will be generated on first run. The SMAPI console will confirm the mod loaded with:
[code][OnlineShop] OnlineShop loaded. Press [B] to open.[/code][line]
[heading]Configuration[/heading]
Edit
[code]config.json[/code]to change the hotkey. Any valid
[code]SButton[/code]works (
[code]"F5"[/code],
[code]"ControllerX"[/code],
[code]"Tab"[/code], etc.):
[code]{ "OpenShopKey": "B" }[/code]The Special Offers feature is also fully configurable: number of daily offers, discount range, purchase limits, and highlight visibility.
[line]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Works alongside most other mods. May conflict with mods that heavily modify the ShopMenu system. Non-destructive — safe to add or remove without affecting saves.
[line]
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Created by [b]Axis[/b]. Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI, ConcernedApe for the game, and the Stardew Valley modding community for making all of this possible.
